description: The file defines a Java interface named 'Metadata' that represents metadata information for a 'Thing' in a system, including methods for creating, modifying, and retrieving metadata instances, typically used within the Eclipse Ditto project.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Creates and returns a new builder for constructing Metadata instances.

methods.name: newMetadata
methods.description: Creates a new immutable Metadata instance initialized with values from a provided JsonObject.

methods.name: toBuilder
methods.description: Returns a mutable builder initialized with the current Metadata instance for modifications.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Overloaded methods to set a value of various types (int, long, double, boolean, String, JsonValue) associated with a key.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a JsonField in the Metadata.

methods.name: setAll
methods.description: Sets multiple JsonFields in the Metadata.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes the value associated with a key from the Metadata.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Returns the Metadata as a JsonObject, optionally filtered by schema version and field selector.
